statement: AMD continues to flag U.S. export restrictions as a risk factor, and its prior-year results carried inventory charges tied to the export control on Instinct MI308 data center GPUs.
why: Export rules have already cost AMD real money once, so China policy remains a live switch that can remove a chunk of accelerator demand overnight.

impact.mechanism: Export restrictions close off a market segment and can force inventory write-downs, cutting realizable accelerator demand regardless of underlying appetite.

evidence.excerpt: the extent of impact of export restrictions imposed by the U.S. on our business
the absence of inventory and related charges associated with the U.S. government export control on AMD Instinct MI308 Data Center GPU products

confidence.basis: Verbatim risk-factor and MD&A language from AMD's Form 10-Q, a primary filing.
